report_identity.report_title: Enterprise Development Holdings Limited Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: The company is an investment holding group whose main reportable segment sells software licenses, hardware products and other products and provides integrated business software solutions, mainly in the PRC.

segments.name: Software and Hardware Business
segments.business_substance: Sale of software licenses, hardware products and other products and provision of integrated business software solutions in the PRC.
segments.source: 2025 annual report, note 3(b), segment reporting, pp.106-108

segments.name: Others
segments.business_substance: Security trading and trading of fresh cassava are aggregated as other unreportable segments.

business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue is mainly recognised at a point in time for sale of software licenses, hardware products and other products; maintenance and other services are recognised over time.
business_notes: 2025 revenue increased to RMB3,858.546 million, mainly from IT product sales and computing infrastructure demand.
The group also held FVTPL securities, tokenised notes and investments in associates, so reported profit contains material non-operating investment gains.

non_recurring_items.item: Fair value gain on financial assets at FVTPL
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Realised and unrealised fair value gains from securities and tokenised notes, not ordinary operating profit.
Equity-accounted associate profit, mainly Hainan Yayi Partnership investment holding exposure.
non_recurring_items.source: 2025 annual report, consolidated profit or loss p.77 and note 15, pp.118-120

funds_assets.business_substance: Cash on hand and demand deposits; RMB80.532 million was placed in PRC financial institutions and subject to PRC remittance restrictions.
Fixed-rate deposits pledged to secure bank borrowings; current asset but not freely detachable before settling paired debt.
funds_assets.source: 2025 annual report, note 20(a), p.124 and note 22(d), p.126

funds_assets.business_substance: Listed Hong Kong and United States equity securities; RMB69.916 million was pledged to secure amounts due to broker.
USD3.0 million Series 2025-01 fixed-rate secured tokenised notes maturing in 2027, with an early redemption notice received after year-end.
Minority stakes in two newly established PRC AI-related companies that had not commenced substantive operations by year-end.

operating_assets.business_substance: Finished goods for hardware and other product sales.
operating_assets.source: 2025 annual report, statement of financial position p.79 and note 16, p.121

operating_assets.business_substance: Includes RMB471.793 million supplier prepayments to offset future purchases, trade receivables and other receivables.
Right to consideration for software and hardware business conditional on future performance.

operating_assets.item: Property, plant and equipment plus right-of-use assets and intangibles
operating_assets.business_substance: Operating equipment, office leases, customer/software intangibles and software patents.
operating_assets.source: 2025 annual report, statement of financial position p.79; notes 11, 12 and 14

investment_assets.business_substance: Associates include Jade Summit and Hainan Yayi Partnership; Hainan Yayi Partnership primarily holds a biomedical listed-company equity investment.

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Third-party loan, former fellow subsidiary loan, unsecured guaranteed bank loans and secured guaranteed bank loans, all repayable within one year.
Broker payable secured by pledged listed equity securities.
financing_liabilities.source: 2025 annual report, note 21 p.126 and note 17(i) p.121

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Advances from customers for sale of hardware products and other products, expected to be settled within 12 months.

operating_liabilities.item: Trade and other payables excluding broker payable
operating_liabilities.business_substance: Trade payables, accruals and tax payables excluding the broker financing balance.

other_liabilities.business_substance: Office and vehicle lease liabilities; treated as continuing operating leases for owner earnback rather than immediate cash-debt deduction.

other_liabilities.source: 2025 annual report, statement of financial position p.79

years.source: 2025 annual report, profit or loss and cash flow statements, pp.77 and 81-82
2025 annual report comparative figures and 2024 annual report cash flow, pp.77, 81 and 2024 pp.73, 77-78
2024 annual report, profit or loss and cash flow statements, pp.73 and 77-78

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Reported profit contains large fair value and associate gains; operating cash flow was negative in 2023 and 2024 and only positive in 2025 after large advances from customers, while supplier prepayments and inventories also expanded sharply. Cash conversion quality is weak for a distributable-profit denominator.

evidence.source: 2025 annual report, consolidated statement of profit or loss, p.77
2025 annual report, consolidated statement of cash flows, p.81

gaps: Annual report does not split all cash balances by listed holding company, offshore subsidiaries and PRC operating subsidiaries beyond the PRC financial-institution balance.
Annual report does not identify which part of group cash corresponds to customer advances or near-term purchase obligations.
Maintenance capital expenditure is not separately disclosed; capital expenditure uses PPE acquisitions plus intangible asset payments as a conservative current-year operating reinvestment proxy.
Market capitalisation is from the rough screening input, not independently re-priced in this extraction.
